works: written from OpenRazer (477f4d6d) and checked against simulated keyboards only (tests/sim-razer-keyboard.mjs)
per keyboard: its interface and wait time (razer_get_report_params) and the transaction id OpenRazer uses for each command
backlight brightness 0-255 (extended 0F/84 and 0F/04; the Huntsman V3 Pro family read through standard 03/83)
game mode (03/80 and 03/00 on the game LED: the keyboard's own Windows-key lock) and the macro light (the same on the macro LED)
polling rate 125-1000 Hz (00/C0 and 00/40), higher rates once the keyboard reads at one: BlackWidow V4 / V4 Pro / V4 75% / V4 TKL HyperSpeed, Huntsman V2 / V2 TKL
battery and charging (07/80, 07/84) on the wireless boards; low-battery warning (07/81, 07/01, raw 12-63) on the BlackWidow V3 Pro
each setting offered only when its read answers; every write read back; every write refused while Razer Synapse runs
doesNotWork: firmware updates (never: Razer's own updater only)
static colour per zone and lighting effects: OpenRazer's matrix effect commands are write-only, so nothing could be read back
the Fn toggle (02/06: write-only), keyswitch optimization and device mode (high risk)
Huntsman V3 Pro TKL brightness (OpenRazer writes it but has no read for it)
macros and key remaps (OpenRazer does them on the host)
